original_requirements.title: Consistent appearance across overviews, lists, and tables

statements.statement: The overviews would have to look more similar. So that you feel like you're still in the same application and not like you're in a slightly different one.

original_requirements.title: Consistent behavior across overviews, lists, and tables

statements.statement: They should actually work exactly the same.

Although there can of course be differences. So in one table I can only select one thing, so it only makes sense that I can select one thing. But in other tables it makes sense that I can also select several things. So it would have to be adjusted accordingly. But basically, they should behave very similarly and identically.

original_requirements.title: Access to all available table and list data

statements.statement: Sometimes I just can't access it or I have to filter it somehow so that I can see all the data.
So you have to change that so that it works.
Then I would also like to be able to edit the data in Excel, for example.
So I need something like an Excel export, and that doesn't work at all.

original_requirements.title: Retention of start-date and end-date filtering

statements.statement: There are filters, and there's also a filter where I can say I want the entries from a certain period, and I can specify the start and end dates. That's OK, we still need that.
It may be that colleagues need them, but I don't need them, so they have to be removed, at least for me.
That would have to be looked at later in the specific tables, in specific overviews.

original_requirements.title: Persistence of filter settings across logins

statements.statement: It's important that I can continue working the next day where I left off the day before.
So the filter settings should be retained when I log back in.

original_requirements.title: Patient search in the patient overview

statements.statement: I would need something that allows me to search for patients in the overview.
So currently I have the first name column and the last name column, but I need something like a search function.

original_requirements.title: Simultaneous patient search by first and last name

statements.statement: So that it searches for both first and last names.
There are a few names where I don't know whether it's a first or last name, so it should search for both at the same time.
